scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://localhost:5173 http://localhost:3001/api/health && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron electron/main.js
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:server: cd server && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ../update-server && npm install
